questions.prompt: What pattern of tissue necrosis is characteristic of ischemic stroke and brain infarcts?
questions.explanation: In the brain, rich hydrolytic lysosomal enzymes rapidly digest dead tissue into a viscous liquid, characteristic of liquefactive necrosis.

questions.prompt: Which triad of factors (Virchow’s Triad) contributes directly to pathological thrombosis?
options: Endothelial injury, stasis or turbulent blood flow, hypercoagulability
questions.explanation: Virchow’s triad describes endothelial damage, abnormal flow (stasis/turbulence), and hypercoagulability as the primary triggers of thrombosis.
